title: Every viewer edit waits while an earlier edit is with neovim
body:
Over the `--stdio` link, `App::write` sends an `edit` and `Nudge` marks it out until neovim sends its text back (8d3105f). Arrow moves pile up while one is out and the palette refuses a creation then (a428352), but a drag, Delete, a paste, a duplicate, a text edit or a property change sent meanwhile carries the old tick, so the plugin drops it and the person has to repeat it with no message.

## Proposal

One gate in `App::write`: while an edit is out, any other write is refused with a status notice (or held and sent when the text returns, if that is as simple), so no edit is dropped silently. Arrow moves keep their accumulation.
